== Course of events ==

After being warned by the Cheshire Cat that all inhabitants of the March Hare's house were quite mad, Alice finds herself at an afternoon tea party with the March Hare, the Hatter, and the Dormouse. At this gathering, the conversation becomes endless and illogical—filled with baffling remarks and bewildering exchanges that defy all sense. Confronted with such exasperating banter, Alice finds herself increasingly frustrated and disgusted by the senseless discourse. In her anger and disgust, she rises from the table and leaves the tea party.

Upon leaving, Alice ventures onward through Wonderland and discovers a curious door set within the trunk of a tree. Through this door, she makes her way back through the glass hall and into the beautiful gardens beyond, where fountains play and flowers bloom.
